items.question: Is the displayed price final?
items.answer: Only prices explicitly shown on the product listing are displayed. Customisation, quantity and delivery can change the final quote, so confirm on WhatsApp.

items.question: Can I request another colour?
items.answer: For many products, yes. Availability depends on the current material/colour stock.

items.question: Can I order more than one?
items.answer: Yes. Enter the quantity and send the enquiry; bulk or multiple-piece requirements can be discussed.

items.question: Can I send a reference image?
items.answer: Yes. After WhatsApp opens, attach the reference image, sketch or screenshot in the chat.
